text:
tara: Heads-up: were rolling out per-route priority buckets + a planned failover dry-run next Wed 2026-05-06 02:30-04:00 UTC. Purpose: validate routing guardrails and graceful degradation for low-priority workload during regional failover. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/routing-guardrails-dryrun (internal). Please ack if your service requires permanent high-priority pinning. :loud_sound:
ben: Ack. Which regions are in scope?
tara: Primary scope: us-east-1 (failover to us-west-2). We'll do a controlled traffic shift in two stages: 5% -> 25% production for 20m each. Priority buckets: high (SLA), medium (soft-SLO), low (best-effort).
ops-eng: Note: low-priority traffic will see increased latency or queued throttle during failover. We'll apply auto-fallback to a compatible model-variant if latency > 1.2s for 10m.
sre_oncall: Status page blurb draft: "Planned routing dry-run in us-east-1 may cause brief latency increases for non-critical routes. No data loss expected; we will monitor closely."
mike: Can we exclude partner-org traffic from the shift? They run critical batch jobs.
tara: Yes. Use the sticky-pin label: "partner-org:high". Add to the exclusion list before EOD Tue.
environment:infra-bot: Scheduled job: routing-dryrun-2026-05-06-02:30. Canary flags set: internal-dev, beta, control-prod-5pct. CI: green.
ben: Rollback criteria?
tara: Abort and rollback if 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 15m, or p99 for high-priority routes > 1200ms for 10m. Post-run checks: traffic stability, KV hit-rate >= 92% within 10m after shift, and consumer error rate.
sre_oncall: I'll update oncall rota and set dedicated channel #dryrun-ops. Escalation: oncall -> eng-lead -> svc-owner.
mike: Ops will update routing-policy config to honor pin labels; I'll push policy PR and link it here.
deploy-bot: PR merged: feature/routing-priority-buckets. Auto-deploy scheduled 01:45 UTC.
tara: We'll enable quiet-window 02:00-04:30 UTC to reduce background jobs; set batch windows to paused. Anyone require extra monitoring dashboards or runbook walkthrough?
ben: I'll add per-priority p50/p95/p99 charts and alert thresholds.
ops-eng: We'll also simulate node drains on a small subset of the failover target to validate graceful placement.
sre_oncall: A final reminder will be posted 24h prior and a short post-mortem within 72h. Please ack if unavailable during the window.
mike: Ack. I'm on-call for the shift.
tara: Thanks team. If you need exclusions, add labels to the tracker: https://go/trackers/routing-dryrun. Live updates will be posted here during the run. :eyes:
